card_name: HDFC Bank Titanium Times Credit Card
fee_details:
- 1st Year Fee: Rs. 500
- 2nd Year Onwards: Rs. 500 (Waived off on yearly spends above Rs. 1.5 Lakhs)
-Annual Fee: Rs. 500
joining_perks:
Welcome gift:
Kick start your association with the Titanium Times card by choosing from an assortment of welcome benefits such as gift vouchers across popular categories including apparel, shopping, dining, movies, wellness, travel etc. 
Reward Points Program:
Earn 7x points on every Rs. 150 spent on all purchases.
reward_structure:
Reward Structure:
- Earn 7 points on every Rs. 150 spent on all purchases
- One or more spends (Monday to Friday) earn 7 points on every Rs. 150 spent. 
-Reward points can be redeemed for exclusive gifts from the HDFC rewards catalogue. 
-The accrued points are valid for 2 years from the date of accrual. 
-Retail transactions that are converted to SmartEMI plan will not receive reward points. Points initially awarded will be reversed under conversion to this plan.
key_highlights:
- One of the best entertainment credit cards with reward points on movie and dining spends.
- Renewal fee waiver on spend of Rs. 1.5 Lakh or above in a year.
- Associated rewards and exciting offers on weekdays.

benefits_features.Dining benefits: Earn 7 points on every Rs. 150 spent on Dining (weekdays)
benefits_features.Renewal benefits: Renewal fee waiver on spend of Rs. 1.5 Lakh or above in a year

how_tos.How to Apply:
You can visit HDFC official website and apply for Titanium Times Credit Card online. Once your application is received, the bank representative would approach you for further processing.
Alternatively, you can also apply through BankBazaar and enjoy the exclusive partner offers.
how_tos.Steps to apply for Titanium Times Card o: Find Eligible, Check Eligibility, Submit the required details to know your eligibility to apply for the card. If you’re eligible, you will have an option to apply for the card. Click on ‘Apply Now’. After the online application form, upload the documents and press ‘Submit’.

reward_point_benefits: Depending on how many points you accumulate, you can redeem them for an array of items such as smartphones, tablets and accessories, speakers, computer accessories, travel bags and more. You can also redeem your points for vouchers, even cashback. Remember, you can accumulate points for 2 years and redeem them for rewards or redeem your spend.

fees_and_charges.Cheque bounce charges: Cheque value of up to Rs.5,000: Rs.200; Cheque value above more than Rs.5,000: Rs.450
fees_and_charges.Over limit charges: 2.5% of the over limit amount (minimum Rs.500)

miscellaneous:
Contactless payments:
Enabled with contactless payment facility, the Times Credit Card provides fast, easy and secure payments at retail outlets. Enjoy the contactless feature at all your everyday purchases below Rs.2,000. Find the contactless symbol on your card and at merchant locations that accept contactless cards.

faqs.1. I have an HDFC Times credit card. Do: Yes, you can earn reward points on every transaction. Every Rs.150 and above (including online transactions) Rs.250 spent on the card would give you 7 reward points. However, there are few exceptions, say, EMI, Wallet Loading and SmartEMI transactions are not eligible for reward points. Even insurance transactions have a minimum of 2000 per transaction. The reward points will have a validity of 2 years from the date of accumulation.
faqs.2. Is the HDFC Titanium Times Mastercard: You’re just one step away from using the card online! Simply activate the card, call the customer service representative for Mastercard Secure Code before transacting online. This requires an additional layer of secure safeguard from fraud.
faqs.3. I lost my HDFC Titanium. What do I do: Please call HDFC credit card toll-free number immediately to report the card. An emergency block for the card is made to recover the lost/ stolen card and receives the bank will issue new card with a different card number. You can also do your next banking account and report the loss under the relevant section.
